#### Quantile Regression

<!-- generated-learning-note -->
This section develops **Quantile Regression**. Read the model specification together with its assumptions and the scale of each reported effect.


Standard regression estimates the mean of the conditional distribution (conditioned on the values of the predictors) of the response variable. Quantile regression is a method for estimating conditional quantiles, including the median.
